name: tou_cool_only_schedule_heat_day_no_preheat_1558
description: Issue #1558: a gas-furnace home limits its weekday 16:15 high-cost schedule to cooling days. On a heating day Climate Advisor no longer pre-heats to the comfort ceiling (76 F) before the period; the thermostat keeps the regular band (heat 68 F).

verdict.summary: A cooling-only schedule does not pre-heat on a heating day
verdict.observed_behavior: Only the band (68 F) is written at 14:00 and 15:30; no 76 F bank; nothing at 16:15.
verdict.expected_behavior: No pre-heat on a heating day for a schedule limited to cooling.

exercises.scenario_effectiveness: Deleting the applies_to filter makes 14:00/15:30 write the 76 F bank (the heat-only twin tou_heat_only_schedule_heat_day_preheats_1558 shows that write), so the 15:59:59 assertion fails.
exercises.two_way_alignment: docs/scheduler-spec.md 'Applies to' section describes the same filter at the single resolve site; production is that filter.
exercises.user_outcome: If this regressed, the gas-furnace home would be pre-heated to 76 F every weekday morning again, saving nothing.
